name: WebBrowserInstance
label: Web Browser Instance
description: Enter or choose the variable that contains the web browser instance to work with.

name: WaitForWebPageTo
label: Wait For Web Page To
description: Select what condition to wait for in the current web page.

selectOptions.label: Contain Element
selectOptions.description: Wait until the web page contains the specified UI element.

selectOptions.label: Not Contain Element
selectOptions.description: Wait until the web page no longer contains the specified UI element.

selectOptions.label: Contain Text
selectOptions.description: Wait until the web page contains the specified text.

selectOptions.label: Not Contain Text
selectOptions.description: Wait until the web page no longer contains the specified text.

name: CheckUiElementState
label: Check UI Element State
description: Check whether a specific UI element is enabled or disabled.

name: UiElement
label: UI Element
description: The UI element to look for in the web page.

name: Text
label: Text
description: The text to look for in the web page content.

name: State
label: State
description: The expected state of the UI element (enabled or disabled).

name: FailWithTimeoutError
label: Fail With Timeout Error
description: Specify whether to fail if the condition isn't met within the specified time.

name: Duration
label: Duration (Seconds)
description: How long to wait before failing if the condition isn't met.
